div.head: ECf 8.3a
div.ab:
Sed postea instigante diabolo ea detinuerunt; et sacerdotes, quia diuites erant, non erant
multum curiosi ad perquirendas eas — quia in multis locis sunt modo IIII ecclesie uel III, ubi tunc temporis non erat nisi una —; et sic inceperunt minui.

div.ab: But afterwards, at the devil's instigation, they withheld them; and the priests, because they were rich, were not very careful to seek them out — for in many places there are now four churches or three where at that time there was only one —; and so they began to diminish.

note.seg: Verf. stellt sich England als schon um 600 in Pfarren (s. d. Gl 1) eingeteilt und seit jeher sie als Empfänger des Zehnten vor: beides verfrüht. Die Gründe, weshalb manche Pfarre den Zehnten verlor, waren wohl eher Krieg, grundherrlicher Übergriff, bäuerlicher Widerstand, Verschenkung des Patronats an Klöster.

The author imagines England as already divided into parishes (s. Gl s.v. 1) around 600, and these as having always been the recipients of tithe: both premature. The reasons why many a parish lost its tithe were probably rather war, encroachment by lords, peasant resistance, the gift of the advowson to monasteries.
